content.short: Webaverse is an open-source Web3 metaverse game engine that anyone can host.
content.description: Webaverse is an open-source Web3 Metaverse game engine that anyone can host. The platform operates in the browser and uses open tools, making it straightforward for users to build and run their own virtual environments within Webaverse. For developers, the API exposes endpoints that can be used to interact with the engine and extend its capabilities, supporting customization and integration as needed.
